subject.title: refactor(protocol): pre-publish cheat-window cleanup and vintage tracking

question: Should this PR be allowed to make the documented breaking changes to the beta-only question, worker, and session-catalog protocol families before public npm publication once the Apple contract regression is fixed?
rationale: The branch’s compatibility premise is intentional product/release policy, not something tests can establish; the supplied assertion that beta breakage was accepted has no corresponding maintainer discussion in the provided review context.

options.title: Approve the pre-publication window
options.body: Confirm the listed protocol families are genuinely unshipped or beta-only, then require the Apple fix and real behavior proof before merging.

options.title: Preserve beta compatibility
options.body: Keep or add a bounded migration path for existing beta clients if those contracts must remain supported through the next release train.

options.title: Split the vintage work
options.body: Land only non-breaking metadata and dead-export cleanup now, and route contract reshapes through a separately approved compatibility plan.

recommendation.title: Approve the pre-publication window
recommendation.body: Confirm the listed protocol families are genuinely unshipped or beta-only, then require the Apple fix and real behavior proof before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: The branch history and PR rationale make this contributor the clearest available contact to document the release-train audit and route the final compatibility decision.
